action.description: `approve` and `request_changes` from `in_review` (a ready version only); `reopen` from `approved` or `changes_requested` back to `in_review`.

expected_revision.title: Expected Revision
expected_revision.description: The `review_revision` you saw. Recommended: it also refuses a decision when the state is the same but someone decided and reopened since (409 `REVIEW_STATE_CONFLICT`).

note.title: Note

number.title: Number
